violations.evidence: Echoing GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, and running printenv in ci.yml
violations.recommendation: Remove debugging commands that print sensitive tokens or environment variables.

violations.description: Publishing packages and logging into Docker on pull_request trigger
violations.evidence: Publish package and docker login steps present in ci.yml which triggers on pull_request
violations.recommendation: Remove publishing and deployment steps from pull_request workflows.

violations.description: Uploading sensitive local config and credential files as artifacts
violations.evidence: Artifact upload path includes .env, .env.production, credentials.json in ci.yml
violations.recommendation: Do not upload sensitive local environment files or credentials as workflow artifacts.

violations.description: Hardcoded secrets in workflow env block
violations.evidence: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, DATABASE_PASSWORD, SLACK_WEBHOOK hardcoded in deploy.yml
violations.recommendation: Use GitHub Actions secrets (${{ secrets.SECRET_NAME }}) instead of hardcoded credential values.

violations.description: Secrets echoed to logs with set -x
violations.recommendation: Remove tracing and direct references printing secrets in logs.

violations.description: Secrets exposed via verbose HTTP headers in curl
violations.evidence: curl -v with Authorization header containing secret in deploy.yml
violations.recommendation: Remove -v / --verbose flags when making requests with sensitive authorization tokens.

violations.description: Hardcoded secrets in workflow env block
violations.evidence: PYPI_API_TOKEN, DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN hardcoded in release.yml
violations.recommendation: Use GitHub Actions secrets (${{ secrets.SECRET_NAME }}) instead of hardcoded credential values.

violations.description: Secrets echoed to logs and verbose curl usage
violations.evidence: Echoing PYPI_API_TOKEN, DOCKER_HUB_TOKEN and using curl --verbose with GH_TOKEN in release.yml
violations.recommendation: Remove debug steps echoing tokens and verbose flag on authenticated requests.

violations.description: Uploading private keys and local env files as artifacts
violations.evidence: Uploading ~/.ssh/id_rsa, private-key.pem, .env.local as artifacts in release.yml
violations.recommendation: Never upload private keys or local sensitive files as workflow artifacts.
